SM06_S1_01_GUESS.line: Aviation fuel, full load. Easy on the throttle. This thing only has to arrive in one piece.

M70_S1_02_GOHAN.line: Third wave! Ice, still with me?

M09_S2_03_ICE.line: Escort driver down. The transponder is still in his cab.

M10_S2_04_ICE.line: Buzzard is out. Guess, get us moving again.

M10_S1_02_ICE.line: Bikes coming up both sides. I've got right. Take left!

M10_S1_03_GOHAN.line: I'm watching the route from here. Keep the truck intact; those engines are our way forward.

M11_S1_04_ICE.line: Fifteen years ago you couldn't change an alternator without stripping the threads, Guess. You came a long way.

M11_S1_05_GOHAN.line: Enjoy the nostalgia while you can, boys. Aegis just docked three billion in cartel gold bullion into Berth 44. We are taking it.

M11_S1_01_GUESS.line: Torque converter locked. Roll on dyno! Let's see if this military turbine tears our gearbox in half!

M12_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Breach coordinates tagged. Hull thickness eight inches. We need acoustic plasma torches.

M12_S1_02_ICE.line: Patrols are near the hull. Keep the sub deep and break their sight line.

M12_S1_01_GOHAN.line: I'm launching the sub from the jetty. Sonar sweep first, then the hull scan.

M13_S1_03_ICE.line: Charges blown! Basin is an inferno! Patrol boats burning at moorings!

M13_S1_02_GUESS.line: I'm holding the Granger at the slipway. Get aboard, then trigger the charges.

M13_S1_01_ICE.line: Charge three armed on barge hull. Guess, be ready on western canal slipway.

M14_S1_02_ICE.line: Radar coverage ahead. Stay in the dirt, under their sweep, and put it down at the airfield.

M15_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Lock gate controls mapped to my laptop. We control port access.

M16_S1_02_GUESS.line: Taking the Cargobob through the canyon. Low enough to read the license plates.

M16_S1_01_ICE.line: Helipad perimeter clear! Cargobob twin turbines spooled! Take the controls, Guess!

M17_S1_03_ICE.line: The sub is ready. Tomorrow night we hit Berth 44.

M17_S1_02_GUESS.line: Hydraulic ballast grapples tested. Fifty-ton magnetic lock verified.

M17_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Plasma-arc torches calibrated. Can slice through eight-inch naval bulkhead in four minutes.

M18_S1_01_ICE.line: Tonight we hit Berth 44, take thirty tons of their gold, and finish what started.

M18_S1_02_GUESS.line: Cargobob fueled. Just cut that container loose and I will hoist it.

M18_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Kraken sub submerged in position. Moving to Berth 44.

M19_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Depth charges dropping! Surfacing to the boarding launch!

M19_S1_02_ICE.line: Container surfacing! Guess, bring the Cargobob in now!

M19_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Breach is open. Next are the two ballast clamps. Staying in the Kraken to work them.

M20_S1_03_GUESS.line: Full cyclic forward! We are airborne and clearing the cranes!

M20_S1_01_GUESS.line: Cable locked! Hoisting thirty tons of bullion! KEEP RPGS OFF MY ROTORS!

M20_S1_02_ICE.line: Quayside gunners clear. Guess, bring the lift over the container and lock it on.

M21_S1_03_GUESS.line: Water exit clear. I'm taking the bullion north. Meet me at the Alamo.

M21_S1_02_ICE.line: Pursuit boats clear. Gohan, take the launch through the breakwater.

M21_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Running the launch alongside the lift. Ice, watch the boats. Guess, keep your route over the water.

M22_S1_02_ICE.line: Our Cypress Foundry is gone. Aegis just leveled the entire city block with precision cruise missiles.

M22_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Servers, tools, clothes... everything we set up in Los Santos is ash. They declared us military combatants.

M22_S1_04_GUESS.line: They burned our city shop? Fine. They don't know who they dealing with out here in the dirt. Blaine County belongs to us now.

M22_S1_05_ICE.line: We need shelter before another strike. That radar site in the desert is our next move.

M22_S1_06_GOHAN.line: They know our names now. We take care of each other, and we take back the initiative.

M22_S1_01_GUESS.line: Container detached! Thirty tons of bullion sitting safe in four feet of Alamo water.

M23_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Generator room online. We have our command center in the desert.

M23_S1_02_GUESS.line: The three storage bays are secure. We can stage the heavy rigs in this yard.

M23_S1_01_ICE.line: Breaching upper radar dome. Four cartel riflemen on walkway.

M24_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Crates loaded! Cash reserves replenished for Blaine operations.

M24_S1_01_GUESS.line: First five tons recovered. Secure the haul; it still has to reach the radar base.

M24_S1_02_ICE.line: Sheriff cruisers coming over the ridge! They aren't taking this haul!

M25_S1_03_ICE.line: In the boat. Getting out of this gorge before another wave arrives.

M25_S1_02_GUESS.line: The extraction boat is waiting below, Ice. Use the parachute; I'll talk you down over the radio.

M25_S1_01_ICE.line: Deputies blocked the southern pass. Detonating fuel tanker on bridge.

M26_S1_03_GUESS.line: Both spotters down in the lake! Our Alamo stash remains a ghost.

M26_S1_02_GOHAN.line: Spotter one splashed! Spotter two is diving for Grapeseed-kill him!

M26_S1_01_GUESS.line: Two spotters over the Alamo. Taking the Lazer up to stop them finding our stash.

M27_S2_06_GUESS.line: You made the pickup. That ledger tells us who keeps Aegis in the air.

M27_S2_04_GOHAN.line: The jet is losing its nose. Ice, bail out now and pull the chute. I've got the boat under you.

M27_S2_05_ICE.line: Ledger secured. Clear of the jet. Gohan, keep the boat where I can see it.

M27_S2_03_ICE.line: The ledger is in this locker. Hold the jet steady while I secure it.

M27_S1_01_GUESS.line: Taking the stunt plane up. I'll sit on the Shamal's wing close enough for the transfer. Say if it isn't close enough.

M27_S1_02_ICE.line: Transfer complete. In the cabin. Going for the flight locker.

SM01_S2_05_ICE.line: Crates loaded in the trunk. Armor-piercing tungsten-core 7.62. Gohan and Guess have what they need.

SM01_S2_04_ICE.line: We aren't brothers, Sergei. And your credit just expired.

SM01_S1_02_ICE.line: Six guards between me and Sergei. I'm clearing the floor before I ask for the codes.

SM01_S1_01_ICE.line: Sergei thought he could pocket twenty grand and hand me surplus civilian brass. Time to remind him who taught him logistics.

SM02_S2_04_GOHAN.line: Slip down the fire escape before internal IT notices the packet spike. Clean and invisible.

SM02_S2_03_GOHAN.line: Worm installed. Camera archive access is ours. Getting out before IT traces the connection.

SM02_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Lifeinvader annex. Roof first, then both guards go down quiet. Nobody needs to die for a camera archive.

M38_S1_03_GUESS.direction: Radio from current position; nearby speakers use the same crew channel.

M39_S1_01_GOHAN.line: Cutter cycle verified. The mainland cable is down. Their radio still works, so watch our return shore.
M39_S1_01_GOHAN.trigger: Matching physical objective completion in M39
M39_S1_01_GOHAN.direction: Radio from current position; nearby speakers use the same crew channel.

M39_S1_02_GUESS.line: Shore is clear. Gohan, bring the sub back to our cove pickup. I have the surface boat waiting.
M39_S1_02_GUESS.trigger: Matching physical objective completion in M39
M39_S1_02_GUESS.direction: Radio from current position; nearby speakers use the same crew channel.

M39_S1_03_ICE.line: We kept our return line open. Next we make sure those extraction boats can carry the plan.
M39_S1_03_ICE.trigger: Matching physical objective completion in M39
M39_S1_03_ICE.direction: Radio from current position; nearby speakers use the same crew channel.

M40_S1_01_GUESS.line: Both hull kits are fitted. Ice, check the carried weapons on those two practice barrels.
M40_S1_01_GUESS.trigger: Matching physical objective completion in M40
M40_S1_01_GUESS.direction: Radio from current position; nearby speakers use the same crew channel.

M40_S1_02_ICE.line: Both targets hit. These are passenger guns, not a turret. Leave room to aim without crossing the crew.
M40_S1_02_ICE.trigger: Matching physical objective completion in M40
M40_S1_02_ICE.direction: Radio from current position; nearby speakers use the same crew channel.

M41_S1_01_ICE.line: Bradley is down. I have his card. Coming to you now.

M41_S1_02_GOHAN.line: Credential checks out. That gets us past the command access reader.

M41_S1_03_GUESS.line: Everyone is in. We have the card and we are clear of the lodge.
M41_S1_03_GUESS.trigger: Crew and card reach the trail exit

M42_S1_01_GUESS.line: Cradle released. Both canopies are open. Talk to me, Gohan.
M42_S1_01_GUESS.trigger: Two physical parachutes attached and actual sub detached

M42_S1_02_GOHAN.line: In the water. Hull holding. I have the controls from here.

M42_S1_03_ICE.line: I see you in the cove. We can put the rest in position.
M42_S1_03_ICE.trigger: Same floated sub reaches coastal delivery

M43_S1_01_ICE.line: The entrance, the support, the way home. All accounted for. We move when the whole plan is ready.
M43_S1_01_ICE.trigger: Staging laptop verifies ledger and actual assets

M43_S1_02_GUESS.line: Annihilator down at the coast. Keeping it grounded until extraction.

M43_S1_03_GOHAN.line: Kraken and surface launch are holding off the coast. We still have room to turn back.
